address: 24 Hubin South Road, Siming, Xiamen, China Mainland
bio: Into the second generation, this family business founded in 1993 features in many Xiamenians' childhood memories. It prides itself on Minnan cooking, especially fresh seafood dishes. The threadfin blanched in claypot has oily, silky flesh and remarkable umami. The deep-fried baby eels in peppered salt are crispy and flavoursome, the mildly spicy kick making them a perfect companion for alcoholic drinks. The friendly service is a plus....
